== Title ==
<span lang="ja">本日最初の獲物だ</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">どちらかを選ぶ。1：牽引ビームの運命数に2を加える。2：「最初の輸送艇が突破しました！」か「ハイパー・エスケープ」をキャンセルする。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">「艦長、反乱軍の宇宙船が我々の警戒区域に接近しつつあります」</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — [[Our First Catch Of The Day]].

'''Lore''' — Captain, Rebel starships are approaching our alert sector.

'''Game text''' — Choose one. Add 2 to a tractor beam destiny. Cancel The First Transport Is Away! or Hyper Escape.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
Lore names a captain and an approaching alert sector. Game text numbers two choices, says 牽引ビーム, and quotes Japanese titles for The First Transport Is Away! and Hyper Escape.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-ourfirstcatchoftheday.gif|Original English face]], [[Our First Catch Of The Day]].</ref>
